items.title: Brooklyn Street Renamed After Ol’ Dirty Bastard
items.summary: Putnam Avenue in Brooklyn's Bed-Stuy neighborhood now shares a name with one of the most influential rappers of all time. Yesterday, with an official ceremony that brought together friends, family, and government officials, Putnam Avenue also became ODB Jones Way, named after Wu-Tang Clan co-founder Ol' Dirty Bastard. items.summary: Following the departure of lead singer Scott Kelly after he admitted to abusing his wife and children in 2022, Neurosis reshaped themselves with new frontman Aaron Turner of Sumac and Old Man Gloom.
